item.description:
### Added - **Search the Fleet window.** Press ⌘F to filter sessions by project, branch or activity; Return jumps to the first match's terminal. An All / Active switch shows only the sessions that need you or are running. - **More in the right-click menu** on a session, in the panel and the Fleet window: Jump to Terminal, Copy Project Path, Copy Git Branch, Copy Session ID, Reveal Folder in Finder, and Stop Current Turn where Perch can stop it.
### Improved - The open menu bar panel does less work each second while agents run. - The first time you open the panel after launch, it appears sooner.
